title: Adaptive multigrid for high-order discontinuous Galerkin methods based on the full approximation scheme
summary: We propose an adaptive multigrid (MG) method for discontinuous Galerkin formulations of elliptic problems using Brandt's full approximation scheme (FAS). Unlike common approaches, this method achieves local $hp$-refinement of hexahedral meshes without the need for hanging nodes. The core component of the FAS-MG method is an overlapping Schwarz smoother, which is optionally accelerated by a Krylov method. This smoother is designed for unstructured curvilinear meshes but maintains a tensor-product structure for fast diagonalization. Numerical experiments demonstrate the exceptional efficiency…
